 Next Move
 Your future, your way. What’s your Next Move?
 Next Move is a one-stop hub for students and families to explore every post–high school pathway—workforce, trades, technical training, community college, or a four-year degree—and find the support to get there. Start with funding: discover FAFSA steps, scholarships you can win, and workforce grants that make training and college more affordable. Dive into the tools below!
 Your Next Move Is Easier Than You Think | Next Move by STCU 
 Make Training and College More Affordable
 Need help with the FAFSA? STCU can provide free assistance.
 Get FAFSA Help
 Ready to schedule an appointment with a FAFSA expert?
 Schedule an Appointment
 Learn more about the importance of filling out the FAFSA and how it can unlock your future.
 FAFSA Opens Doors
 Take your future into your own hands. Learn about resources available to you and your family.
 Explore Student Resources
 Get money for career training or college.
 Learn About Career & College Funding
 Learn more about Workforce Pell and Washington workforce training opportunities.
 Learn About Workforce Pell
 Coffee's On Us 
 Nominate your non-profit organization for a chance to win a coffee delivery from KHQ and Craven's Coffee!
